name: ZaoSeq Bopomofo v0.2 runtime closure plan
scope: Select and freeze the production LM cache capacity for the sealed-PASS v0.2 final system and record its runtime profile. Nothing semantic changes: candidates, scores and teacher picks are fixed by benchmarks/frozen/V0.2_SEMANTIC.json and the cache is output-equivalent.
system: round3_winner = S5_tatoeba_common_voice exactly as locked in V0.2_SEMANTIC.json
protocol: unchanged from the Round 3 addendum: Coverage-DEV v1.1 (300) then GOV-DEV (400) in fixed order; 20 warm-up cases; 5 repetitions; one fresh process per run; decoder-only for every capacity candidate (disabled, bounded_8mb 22000, bounded_16mb 44000, bounded_32mb 88000, unbounded_reference); teacher-only and end-to-end (frozen Laya K=4) at the selected capacity
selection_rule: the addendum rule verbatim: only bounded capacities are eligible; median over repetitions of per-repetition decoder-only p50 / p95 / p99; acceptable if p50 <= 1.05 * best_p50, p95 <= 1.05 * best_p95, p99 <= 1.10 * best_p99; choose the smallest acceptable capacity; the result is accepted whatever it is

environment_preconditions.E1_power_plan: Windows power plan is High performance / Ultimate Performance (not Balanced / Power saver)
environment_preconditions.E2_no_interactive_load: none of these processes is running: ChatGPT, codex*, obs*, chrome, msedge (browser), Discord, ms-teams / Teams, LINE, WINWORD, Taskmgr, steam; the desktop app hosting the measuring session is allowed
environment_preconditions.E3_cpu_stability: 40 timed runs of a fixed pure-Python workload: max / median <= 1.15 and coefficient of variation <= 0.05
environment_preconditions.E4_idle_cpu: system CPU utilization averaged over 10 s (before the probe) <= 5%
environment_preconditions.when: checked immediately before the benchmark; E1-E3 checked again immediately after it

measurement_validity.V1_output_equivalence: every capacity gives the same output signature (candidate texts and scores on all 700 cases)
measurement_validity.V2_decoder_repetition_spread: for every capacity, max / min over the 5 per-repetition p50 values <= 1.20 and the same for p95
measurement_validity.V3_teacher_repetition_spread: at the selected capacity, max / min of the per-repetition teacher-only p50 <= 1.20 and of the end-to-end p50 <= 1.20
measurement_validity.V4_environment_after: E1, E2 and E3 still hold after the benchmark

decision.RUNTIME_READY: all preconditions and validity checks hold; the rule's capacity is frozen in benchmarks/frozen/V0.2_RUNTIME.json
decision.BLOCKER: a precondition fails before the benchmark starts; nothing is measured or selected
decision.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: a validity check fails; the run is kept as evidence, no capacity is frozen, and a new run needs a quiet machine

outputs.freeze: benchmarks/frozen/V0.2_RUNTIME.json: production cache capacity, runtime config, environment, latency and memory, output-equivalence evidence, semantic and sealed references

not_claimed: latency on other machines; the numbers describe this machine under the recorded environment
